_comment: OpenClaw MCP server config. Most OpenClaw skills wrap an MCP server; this registers mnesio directly. Build first: `cargo build -p mnesio-mcp --release`. The key is typically `mcpServers` (check your OpenClaw version). Share MNESIO_DATA across agents/users only if they should share memory; otherwise pass a per-user `tenant` on each tool call (mnesio's scope boundary).
